Caltrain Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release: Query real-time Caltrain schedules and stations using GTFS data.
- Supports searching next scheduled train departures between stations.
- Includes tool to list all available Caltrain stations.
- Requires user to provide an API key before use.
- Fully guided user prompt system to collect required parameters and handle missing information.
- Strict rule: No schedule data is shown if API key is missing—user must supply a valid key first.
